label: AEP-001 - Hammerfest coastal
scope_note: Bounding box 23.40-24.12 E, 70.45-70.78 N. Urban / diffuse plus aquaculture sources into the Hammerfest coastal system.
notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-28; the former national AEP-001 was wiped. Sources: one pop-weighted REACH node. Little measured point-source signal; the aquaculture belt carries most of the near-farm sediment monitoring.

label: AEP-002 - Repparfjord inner
scope_note: Bounding box 24.13-24.42 E, 70.42-70.52 N. Inner Repparfjorden: historic Folldal Verk submarine tailings plus Ulveryggen catchment runoff.
notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-28 from the former AEP-002 Repparfjorden. Highly contaminated inner-fjord sediment (Sternal 2017, class IV-V); not a copper exporter. River may or may not be a relevant source.
